messages:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER: ben-oncall (primary) — Latency SLO breach: inference.p99 > 5s for last 5m, streaming stalls increasing. Paging channel: incidents. :rotating_light:
ben-oncall: seeing spikes across prod-us-east, p95 ~1.2s -> 2.8s, p99 into 6-10s on streaming endpoints. Adding notes here.
ben-oncall: root traces point to auth/config fetch path — delays in token validation calls to token-store-db.
ben-oncall: tagging @sarah-plat and @raj-db — can you confirm if DB is healthy?
sarah-plat: looking now, controlplane metrics show a surge in config-fetch latency (95th 500ms -> 3s) and a backlog on the config service queue. No obvious infra CPU OOMs.
raj-db: DB IOPS and locks look ok, but token-store app shows increased p99 latency on auth lookups. Suspect a rate-limit/backpressure tear in the token cache layer after a deploy earlier.
emily-sre: observed connection churn from configfetch->token-store around 1746499800, maybe retry storms. Streaming clients time out and then re-establish, amplifying load.
jaime-ml: customer-facing streaming sessions report stalled tokens mid-stream, payloads keep buffering. Any quick mitigations besides scaling?
ben-oncall: immediate mitigation attempt: enabling conservative fallback policy to route to cached-policy model variant and disable live feature-flag checks for streaming routes. Doing rollout now.
sarah-plat: initiating rollback of last controlplane deploy (config-fetch service) in parallel. Deploy bot: @deploy-bot can you confirm rollback started?
deploy-bot: Rolling back controlplane/config-fetch v2026.03.15.13 -> previous stable v2026.03.12.22. ETA 90s for traffic shift.
raj-db: while rollback happens, we can also temporarily relax token-store rate limits for internal controlplane services. Propose: increase token-store concurrency cap from 200 -> 500 for 10 minutes. Approve?
emily-sre: +1, wide nets are ok short term. Also enable prefix/KV cache for auth tokens at the controlplane side to reduce DB trips. Jaime, can you route streaming to cached token path?
jaime-ml: yes, I can flip route on the inference gateway to use local prefix token cache for streaming only. Doing canary 10% now.
ben-oncall: canary looks healthy — p99 for that 10% is down to ~800ms. Increasing to 50% canary.
customer-success: FYI received two chats from customers about streaming stalls on their sessions. No major outages yet but UX impacted.
sarah-plat: rollback finished on controlplane. New traffic pattern shows config-fetch latency dropping back to baseline in the last 30s.
raj-db: token-store rate-limit increase applied. Monitoring connections; error budget burn should slow.
jaime-ml: gateway routing to cached token path at 50% -> 100%. Streaming stalls cleared for routed sessions.
ben-oncall: p95 back to ~300ms, p99 holding ~900-1200ms. Continuing to monitor for tail spikes.
emily-sre: observed some residual tail from clients that retried heavily earlier; we can mitigate by purging retry spikes with a short-lived 503-surface to force clients to backoff — would like ops-bot to coordinate.
ops-bot: Gate 1: hold new long-lived streams from <internal test> for 2m. Issued via controlplane rate policy.
jaime-ml: working on warmup for KV caches to avoid cold-start tail for newly routed sessions. Script: 
```
# warm auth prefix cache
for i in $(seq 1 1000); do curl -s "https://controlplane.internal/token-cache/warm?prefix=user$(($i%100))" >/dev/null; done
```
ben-oncall: good. Also want to assess customer impact and decide if we need an incident page. CS, any escalation?
customer-success: small number of customers saw degraded sessions for ~6-9 minutes. One enterprise reported degraded webhook processing. Recommend a status post for transparency.
ben-oncall: putting incident into active triage. Impact: Partial degraded streaming for small subset of customers (10-50 sessions), SLO breach p99 observed 6m window. Possible action items: RCA, deploy rollback timeline, mitigate retry storms, improve token-cache warmup.
sarah-plat: next steps: (1) confirm rollback stable for 15m, (2) revert temporary rate-limit relax after traffic normalizes, (3) add circuit-breaker in config-fetch to skip non-essential feature flag lookups for streaming RPCs.
raj-db: followups on DB side: investigate token-store query hotspot and missing index introduced by last change; add metrics for token-store queue depth and per-endpoint throttles.
jaime-ml: ML followups: add local hot-cache for tokens in inference gateway, better backoff on client SDKs for streaming reconnect, and a graceful degrade to shorter tokens + reauth flow.
emily-sre: note: we'll run a controlled chaos test in staging to exercise token-store rate limits and confirm backoff works. Schedule next week.
ben-oncall: handoff to emily-sre for follow-up and RCA. I'll update the incident channel and kick off a postmortem doc. Thanks all. :heart:
emily-sre: taking handoff — will create postmortem and customer impact summary, cc: @customer-success for draft status page.
ben-oncall: incident closed for oncall shift, leaving monitoring on. last observed p99 1.1s at 1746500180, trending down.
ops-bot: Incident bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status -> mitigated, oncall handoff -> emily-sre, duration -> 00:12:30, impact -> partial streaming degradation, customers affected -> limited.
customer-success: I'll prepare the status page text and send to legal review.
emily-sre: logging the incident timeline and tags: controlplane, token-store, configfetch, rollback, streaming-tail, rate-limits.
ben-oncall: final note: add an alert for token-store retry storm (consecutive 5m > 2000 retries) and a dashboard for streaming tail latency by route.
